method: Ordinary no-axe native InputFrames; fixed sim ticks; actual production follow camera. Every tick from doorsOpen through+0.5s records conservative4m-wide/3.7m-high projected body boxes. Entire boxes outside a frustum plane prove absence; overlap cannot prove visibility. Production frames and a presentation-only camera control are retained. CrowdView ID masks do not cover NPC-dressed infected and are not used. No performance timing.
